blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Police arrested an individual considered number 9 in the list of most wanted persons in Ilocos Sur. The suspect was nabbed during the enforcement of a warrant of arrest in Caoayan town on Friday, Oct. 9. The suspect, a 34-year-old construction worker and a resident of the municipality, was apprehended by a tracker team led by Lt. Joy Callejo. The operation was under the supervision of Lt. Ryan Jay Quiocho, officer-in-charge of the Caoayan Municipal Police Station (MPS). The case stemmed from a warrant issued on Thursday for an alleged violation of Section 28(A), in relation […]...
